## Change and reason

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior, and phase/scope.

## Validation

- [ ] Frozen installation, lint, TypeScript and production build
- [ ] Relevant automated tests (include counts and browser/device scope)
- [ ] Complete and production dependency audits (include unresolved findings)
- [ ] Existing branding, pricing and Calendly/Shopify links preserved
- [ ] No real athlete data, credentials or private media in code/test artifacts

## Risks and approval

List outstanding decisions and staging/rollback evidence. A successful build does not establish security readiness. Production deployment and merging into main require owner approval. Do not activate payments or proceed into another phase without authorization.
